title: Care Desk Rules on Remedies and Claim Values for the Live Pet Health Guarantee
content:
An accepted Live Pet Health Guarantee claim is settled with one of the remedies available under its guarantee type.

## Rule

- **Replacement.** A replacement animal is the same species where the guarantee type requires it; a higher-priced replacement may be taken by paying the difference where the type allows it; and the replacement is collected within the replacement collection window of the type.
- **Store credit.** Store credit is valid for the store credit period of the type.
- **Refund.** A refund goes to the original payment, where the type's requirement of the original purchase record is met.
- **Value.** The value of the remedy is the claimed animals' price paid.
- **Outside veterinary costs.** Outside veterinary costs for a covered illness are reimbursed up to the largest reimbursement of the type, by the reimbursement method of the type, with an itemized invoice where the type requires one.
- **Restocking.** Aquarium customers are advised to wait the restocking period of the type before restocking the tank.

## Value and the covered value of the line

The covered value of a purchase line starts as the number of animals bought on the line multiplied by the price paid per animal. A remedy given on the line books out of that covered value, so the covered value remaining is the price paid less the remedies given. The value of a claim's remedy is the number of animals claimed multiplied by the price paid per animal on that line.

| Hypothetical line | Animals bought | Price paid per animal | Covered value at purchase | Animals claimed | Remedy value | Covered value remaining |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fish line | 10 | 4.00 USD | 40.00 USD | 3 | 12.00 USD | 28.00 USD |
| Bird line | 2 | 85.00 USD | 170.00 USD | 1 | 85.00 USD | 85.00 USD |

## Points of judgement

- The remedy is one of the options listed for the guarantee type; an option not listed for the type is not a remedy of that claim.
- The remedy's value is fixed by the price paid for the animals claimed, not by the price of a replacement chosen. Hypothetical illustration: where the type allows a dearer replacement for a fish whose price paid was 4.00 USD, a replacement priced 6.00 USD is taken by paying the difference of 2.00 USD.
- A refund is made to the original payment, and only where the original purchase record requirement of the type is met.
- Reimbursement of outside veterinary costs is limited to a covered illness and to the largest reimbursement of the type, paid by that type's reimbursement method.
- The restocking wait is advice given to aquarium customers; it is stated as a number of days for each aquatic guarantee type.
